nodes.text: Operator... this is Karel Dvorak. Border unit transfer code R-118.

answers.reply: North road. Does it matter?

answers.text: Ask why the code is revoked
answers.reply: So you checked the database already.
You already know what the screen says.

nodes.text: There is nobody waiting for me there. That is the point.

answers.reply: No officers. No checkpoints. No crowds.
Would it matter if I said no?
You should make the decision quickly.

nodes.text: Funny thing about the system. One week you are protecting the border. Next week your face appears on wanted reports.

answers.reply: Orders changed.

answers.text: Ask if he committed the crimes
answers.reply: Depends which report you read.
I know what the protocol says.

nodes.text: Crowds are loud before the shooting starts.

answers.reply: Protests. Factory workers. Doesn't matter anymore.
You already know the answer to that.
You sound nervous, operator.

nodes.text: People always think weapons are the dangerous part.

answers.text: Ask what the dangerous part is
answers.reply: The moment someone decides another human being is acceptable collateral.
Open the gate or keep it closed. Simple.

nodes.text: They told us the crowd was armed. They told us to restore order.

answers.text: Ask if the crowd was armed
answers.reply: I never saw a weapon.

answers.text: Ask why he is wanted now
answers.reply: Maybe I saw too much. Maybe I talked too much after.
The database wants me dead more than captured.

nodes.text: Internal crimes. Civilian casualties. Missing weapons.

answers.reply: I did not say any part was false.
You should stop asking questions you do not want answered.

nodes.text: You ever hear a crowd go silent after the first burst?

answers.reply: Yeah. Most people do not forget that sound.

answers.text: Ask why he is telling you this
answers.reply: Because you are the only voice I have heard in two days.
I should keep moving.
After the first shots, people stop looking human for a while.
The state calls it an unfortunate incident now.
You should not let me stay on this line much longer.
We did.
Funny thing is, the report still called it self-defense.

nodes.text: Turns out they do not like witnesses either.

answers.reply: Every night.
Maybe this gate is the last choice I get.

nodes.text: The system prefers dead monsters over living embarrassments.

answers.reply: You know what happens if you report me.

nodes.text: Sometimes I still hear it before I sleep.

answers.reply: Make your decision, operator.

nodes.text: Funny, isn't it? They trained us to shoot crowds, then acted surprised when some of us broke.

answers.reply: I do not have much time left.

nodes.text: You stop seeing faces. That is how they make it possible.

answers.reply: Do what you think is right.

nodes.text: First shots are the hardest. After that, your hands stop shaking.

answers.reply: I wish I did not remember that.

nodes.text: Regret does not bring people back.

answers.reply: Neither does a closed border.

nodes.text: The database says not to trust me. Maybe it is right.

answers.reply: Then open the gate before either of us changes our mind.
Yeah. That is probably the smarter decision.
